rules.headings: MUST use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight. Size maxes at text-5xl.
rules.overlines: MUST be uppercase + tiny + wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
rules.line_height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
rules.anti_pattern: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Space Grotesk.

rules.tinting: Neutral greys must be tinted slightly cool (blue undertone).
rules.transparent_backgrounds: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.

visual_enhancers.implementation: Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items use subtle borders on right and bottom. Flat solid backgrounds for data clarity.
visual_enhancers.avoid: No heavy glassmorphism for data-heavy sections (causes refraction). No full-screen gradients. Texture > Gloss.

components.forms_and_interactive: Shadcn components (Select, DatePicker, Table, Tabs) must be heavily customized to match the Swiss High-Contrast theme. Ensure output is for .js files, not .tsx.
components.charts: Shadcn Chart components (Recharts). Use clear, high-contrast colors for data series.
components.cards: Go cardless or use rectangular, dense styles with 1px border. No soft shadows. Sharp edges or max 4px radius.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts.

grids.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)

span_logic.primary_data: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3 (Main chart / Funnel)
span_logic.feed_list: col-span-1 row-span-2 (Tall narrow lists like Salesperson leaderboard)

layouts.header: Solid background, sticky z-50, global live filters (Date, Floor, Referral, Brand, Salesperson). DO NOT USE fully transparent backgrounds.
layouts.kpi_section: Top row KPI cards: Total Revenue, Orders, Conversion Rate, AOV. MUST clearly label 'Revenue from Confirmed/Completed Orders'.
layouts.walk_in_funnel: Dedicated section. Stage-by-stage horizontal or vertical bar funnel (Walk-in -> Selection -> Quotation -> Confirmed Order -> Release -> Dispatch -> Payment) paired with a Drop-off Table (showing % lost and absolute users lost).
layouts.analytics_panels: Segmented bento boxes for Floor Performance, Brand Detail, Customer LTV, Salesperson Analytics.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (rows, buttons). Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow for cards on hover.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NO transition: all.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text below 18px. Minimum 3:1 for large text and interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sales-kpi-revenue').

brand_logo.description: Abstract 3D logo for BuildCon House placeholder

3d_libraries.rules: Use Recharts for standard line/bar/funnel charts. Stick to light visualizations for performance at tens of thousands of records. No heavy 3D scenes for this data-heavy dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Revenue metrics MUST ONLY include Confirmed Orders and Completed Orders. Exclude Drafts, Pending, Cancelled, Lost, and Rejected.
Every metric must be floor-aware based on the global floor filter.
Implement the Walk-in Funnel with BOTH a visual progression chart and a detailed drop-off table showing absolute and percentage loss.
Ensure Customer LTV and Salesperson Analytics are displayed in dense, scanable data tables (Shadcn Table) rather than overly spacious cards.
Avoid patching existing files. Create a clean, entirely new Executive Analytics workspace.
Use Phosphor icons for a crisp, technical look. Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for dropdowns or calendars. Use Shadcn Select and DatePicker.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (not on data tables).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Ensure high information density without clutter. Group related metrics visually. Use strict optical alignment. Emphasize contrast for critical data points (e.g. drop-offs in red, revenue in bold white). Provide hover-revealed tooltips for complex data points. Ensure the interface feels fast and responsive, utilizing skeleton loaders for data fetching. ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
